g.text: Group money on NEAR. Every action is a transaction the member signs in their own wallet.
no Terra server · no Terra keys · no Terra custody
Vite + React · static site on Vercel (useterra.app) · Android via Capacitor
record.ts routes each request by size
dm.ts tweetnacl box, key stays here
social.ts each write is read back
all the money and every record live on chain
made by sputnikv2.testnet · treasury in NEAR
· Tier limits are checked by Terra, not by the DAO contract. On chain, one trusted vote can approve a transfer of any size, so keep the trusted list small.
· The allowance contract is the hard, on-chain cap: daily cap, per-payment max, expiry and freeze.
· Cross-chain: the app makes live dry quotes (NEAR Intents has no testnet); a real mainnet payout goes through a keyless script, sent from the person's own wallet.
· DMs: message bodies are end-to-end encrypted, but who wrote to whom, and when, is public.
